'''''Mammillaria bocasana''''' is a species of [[cactus]] in the subfamily [[Cactoideae]]. It is often sold as a "powder puff" cactus,<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|title = The Complete Illustrated Guide to Growing Cacti & Succulents|last = Anderson|first = Miles|publisher = Lorentz Books|year = 2008|isbn = 978-0-7548-1842-7|location = London|pages = 84}}</ref> and also as a "Powder Puff Pincushion."<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url = http://www.llifle.com/Encyclopedia/CACTI/Family/Cactaceae/8970/Mammillaria_bocasana|title = Mammillaria bocasana Poselg.|access-date = 20 June 2015|website = Encyclopedia of Cacti|publisher = Encyclopedia of Living forms}}</ref> The plant is protected from collecting in the wild in Mexico.<ref name="iucn status 12 November 2021" />

== Habitat ==
In its natural habitat of Northern central [[Mexico]], it is found between 1650–2300 meters above sea level.<ref name=":2" /> It grows on canyon walls, in volcanic rock and in semi-desert environs, often under bushes of native plants.<ref name=":2" /> It has been listed as "Least Concern" on the [[IUCN Red List|IUCN Red List of Threatened Species]] since 2009.<ref name="iucn status 12 November 2021" />

== Description ==
''Mammillaria bocasana'' is hemispherical in shape. It has "white, hair-like spines" that cover up its radial and hooked central spines.<ref name=":0" /> During the spring and summer, it bears several cream-colored flowers.<ref name=":1">{{Cite book|title = Cacti|last = Hewitt|first = Terry|publisher = Anness Publishing Limited|year = 2013|isbn = 978-1-78019-284-0|location = London|pages = 32}}</ref> Later it bears a red cylindrical fruit that contains reddish-brown seeds which display partially lateral [[Hilum (biology)|hilum]].<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://mammillarias.net/gallery/mammillaria_species.php?searchstring=bocasana%20ssp%20bocasana&lg=uk|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20061002045424/http://www.mammillarias.net/gallery/mammillaria_species.php?searchstring=bocasana%20ssp%20bocasana&lg=uk|url-status = usurped|archive-date = October 2, 2006|title = Mammillaria bocasana ssp bocasana|access-date = 20 June 2015|website = Mammillarias.net}}</ref> Its form can be variable, with many different varieties or subspecies.<ref name=":2" />

== Cultivation ==
''Mammillaria bocasana'' can be propagated from seed.<ref name=":0" /> As it grows, it offsets, creating large mounds.<ref name=":1" /> This cactus is prone to rot and can tolerate temperatures of -7 degrees Celsius (20 degrees Fahrenheit) for short amounts of time.<ref name=":0" /> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/106174/Mammillaria-bocasana/Details | title = ''Mammillaria bocasana'' | website = www.rhs.org | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 3 January 2021}}</ref>
